extracted.intended_audience: literary scholars, editors, librarians, critics, and readers of short fiction (compilers of bibliographies/yearbooks)
extracted.subtask_description: An editorial/bibliographic index (Yearbook) listing notable short stories, volumes, translations, and articles in American magazines for a defined date range, with conventions for marking distinction and prior inclusion. It documents inclusion/exclusion rules, annotation symbols, and standard abbreviations used in the index.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marking special excellence with an asterisk
rubrics_metrics.description: Note. Stories of special excellence are indicated by an asterisk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an asterisk (or asterisk before a title) to denote stories/titles given special distinction in the Roll of Honor/volumes lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index figures indicating prior inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: The index figures 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 prefixed to the name of the author indicate that his work has been included in the Rolls of Honor for 1914, 1915, 1916, 1917, and 1918 respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefix author names with the numeric markers 1–5 to show inclusion in the specified earlier Rolls of Honor; include these markers in the index entries to convey historical inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclude reprints
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When compiling the Roll/list, omit items that are reprints rather than original appearances within the covered period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of works to include in 'Volumes of Short Stories' list
rubrics_metrics.description: This list includes single short stories, collections of short stories, textbooks, and a few continuous narratives based on short stories previously published in magazines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include standalone short stories, collected volumes, relevant textbooks, and continuous narratives derived from magazine-published short stories when assembling the 'Volumes of Short Stories' index.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include forthcoming volumes announced for publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Volumes announced for publication in the autumn of 1919 are listed here, though in some cases they had not yet appeared at the time this book went to press.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List volumes announced for publication within the covered timeframe even if they had not physically appeared by press time; note their announced status where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date-range limits for foreign short stories list
rubrics_metrics.description: THE ROLL OF HONOR OF FOREIGN SHORT STORIES IN AMERICAN MAGAZINES NOVEMBER, 1918, TO SEPTEMBER, 1919
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit inclusion in the 'Foreign Short Stories in American Magazines' Roll to items published within the stated date window (Nov 1918–Sept 1919).

rubrics_metrics.name: Date-range limits for 'Articles on the Short Story'
rubrics_metrics.description: ARTICLES ON THE SHORT STORY OCTOBER, 1918, TO SEPTEMBER, 1919
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit the bibliographic listing of articles about the short story to that specified period (Oct 1918–Sept 1919).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use standard abbreviations for periodicals
rubrics_metrics.description: The following abbreviations are used in this index: — Am American; Ath Athenseum; Atl Atlantic Monthly; Bel Bellman; B. E. T Boston Evening Transcript; ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the standardized set of abbreviated periodical titles in the index entries (use the provided abbreviation key) to maintain concision and consistency in citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selected library lists organized as 'Top Ten' per category
rubrics_metrics.description: A SELECTED LIBRARY LIST: I. Ten Books by American Authors; II. Ten Books by English and Irish Authors; III. Ten Books of Translations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curate and present compact 'Top Ten' lists in distinct categories (American; English & Irish; Translations), using the asterisk to indicate distinguished selections within each list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate original language for translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Translations are listed with language in parentheses (e.g., (Yiddish.), (French.), (Russian.), etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When listing translated works, note the original language in parentheses immediately following the author or entry to clarify provenance.
